It is understandable that QET would forbid to modify a read-only element, but it is detrimental that it forbids to copy all or part of it.



The current workaround is to save the read-only element as a temporary element in the user collection, and then copy from it.

Best regards,



Olivier (QET 0.80c)

bugs.summary: crash after modify the nomenclature contents - can be avoided
bugs.description:
v0.9 on Windows 7:

on 1st folio, select the table, and in nomenclature property tab "Contents" 

- modified the included types to reduce the number of lines, 

- update the 1st nomenclature folio page is not complete (with only the elements)

The manual on nomenclature explains nothing on configuration,ow are filled the elements information, types of elements  and chained pages. Some hints are in several forum topics.

created diagram with around 15 elts and many connections.

Several linked nomenclature folio, added when msg  " veuillez ajouter un nouveau tableau ou régler les tableaux existant...".

modified the nomenclature "Contents" for the columns, and the types => uncheck "borniers" & "simples".

I deletes all these folios, recreate one and one content with menclature, defining the correct types, and its OK.



So if the configuration is defined BEFORE linkin tables on several folios, the crash is avoided.
